name: chainpe-wallet
display_name: ChainPe — Monad Wallet for AI Agents
description: Monad wallet for Claude. Discover ChainPe services ranked by ERC-8004 reputation and pay for them with x402 USDC — no API keys, no accounts.
long_description:
Give Claude a Monad wallet wired into the ChainPe registry. Tools:

- **search_bazaar** — Discover x402-gated services (indexer API or on-chain registry), ranked by ERC-8004 reputation
- **x402_fetch** — Fetch a URL, paying an x402 v2 `402` in Monad USDC automatically
- **pay** — Pay for an x402 call and get parsed data plus the receipt (tx hash + MonadVision link)
- **check_balance** — USDC and MON balance and wallet address
- **transfer_usdc** — Send USDC to any Monad address
- **transfer_mon** — Send native MON
- **spending_report** — What the agent has spent today and the limits
- **request_funding** — EIP-681 top-up link plus the testnet faucets
- **give_feedback** — Post an ERC-8004 reputation score for a provider

Only offers that are `exact`, on your Monad network, in Monad USDC and within your budget are ever signed. The per-call and daily budget is stored in ~/.chainpe/spending.json, so restarting Claude does not reset it (it resets at UTC midnight).

Defaults to Monad testnet; set the network to `monad` for mainnet.

private_key.title: Wallet Private Key (0x…)
private_key.description: Private key of the wallet that signs x402 USDC payments on Monad. Use a dedicated low-balance wallet. Stored in your OS keychain.

max_per_call.title: Max USDC per Payment
max_per_call.description: Offers above this are refused before anything is signed.

max_per_day.title: Max USDC per Day (UTC)
max_per_day.description: Daily total, persisted across restarts; resets at UTC midnight.

chainpe_indexer_url.title: ChainPe Indexer URL
chainpe_indexer_url.description: Optional. When set, search_bazaar uses the indexer API instead of reading the registry on-chain.

chainpe_registry_address.title: ChainPe Registry Address
chainpe_registry_address.description: Optional override of the ChainPeRegistry contract on Monad.

erc8004_reputation_registry.title: ERC-8004 Reputation Registry
erc8004_reputation_registry.description: Optional override. Defaults to the canonical ERC-8004 Reputation Registry on the selected Monad network.
